title: 我的伙伴
description: 本模组添加了一只名为"我的伙伴"的宠物狐狸。它会认你为主、跟随你冒险、免疫所有伤害，还能帮你打开末影箱。登录游戏时自动获得，无需合成。This mod adds a pet fox called 'My Companion'. It recognizes you as its owner, follows you on adventures, is immune to all damage, and can help you open Ender Chests.
body:
# 本模组使用AI制作，作者不会任何代码有bug勿喷

如何获得
首次进入世界：自动获得一只已认主的伙伴
；刷怪蛋：在创造模式中使用

交互操作

右键点击伙伴	切换跟随 / 原地等待模式（屏幕中央会显示提示文字）

潜行 + 右键点击伙伴	         打开末影箱

潜行 + 右键 + 雪球	         变更为白色（雪狐）皮肤

潜行 + 右键 + 甜浆果	      变回红色（狐狸）皮肤

特性

完全免疫伤害：任何攻击、摔落、火焰都无法伤到它
自动跟随：距离主人超过 10 格时会主动跟上
超远传送：距离主人超过 20 格时会尝试瞬移到主人身边（冷却 5 秒）
不会繁殖，不能被拴绳拴住

注意事项

伙伴在等待模式下不会主动传送，如果你走得太远且它处于等待模式，记得回头找它
传送需要 5 秒冷却，频繁远距离移动时可能感觉它传送变慢
如果传送频繁失败（例如你在狭小洞穴或悬崖边），请走到开阔平地上

# This mod was created using AI; the author doesn’t know any code, so please don’t blame them for any bugs.

How to Obtain
First time entering the world: You automatically receive a tamed companion.
; Spawn Egg: Use in Creative mode.

Interactions

Right-click your companion    Toggle between Follow and Wait modes (a prompt will appear in the center of the screen)

Sneak + Right-click your companion             Open the Ender Chest

Sneak + Right-click + Snowball	         Change to white (snow fox) skin

Crouch + Right-click + Sweet Berry          Change back to red (fox) skin

Features

Fully immune to damage: No attacks, falls, or fire can harm it
Auto-follow: Will actively follow if more than 10 blocks away from the owner
Long-range teleport: Will attempt to teleport to the owner if more than 20 blocks away (5-second cooldown)
Does not breed and cannot be leashed

Notes

The companion will not teleport automatically while in wait mode. If you wander too far and it is in wait mode, remember to turn back to find it
Teleportation has a 5-second cooldown; it may feel slower during frequent long-distance travel
If teleportation frequently fails (e.g., in narrow caves or near cliff edges), please move to open, flat ground
